profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with several years of experience building full-stack and backend production systems, primarily using TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, AWS, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
 
My work has included production AI and LLM integrations, third-party APIs, internal platforms, automation, observability, CI/CD, and customer-facing products. I helped lead an OpenAI-powered tagging system that contributed approximately $31.2M in incremental annual revenue, and built event-driven automation that generated $1.4M in revenue uplift while eliminating more than 1,000 hours of manual work.
 
I tend to work on problems where the requirements are not completely defined upfront. I like understanding why we're building something, figuring out the technical approach, and owning more than just the individual ticket, from system design and implementation through rollout, monitoring, and production support.
 
I've spent most of my career in fintech and learned a lot from building reliable systems around payments and commerce. Working with production AI opened another direction for me, and I'm interested in applying that experience to AI, consumer products, creative technology, and other products I find interesting.
 
I'm primarily interested in Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer, Backend Engineer, Product Engineer, AI Product Engineer, and Software Engineer, AI roles.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Helped lead development of an LLM-powered product tagging system using OpenAI APIs, improving search and discovery and contributing approximately $31.2M in incremental annual revenue.

Developed a full-stack, event-driven platform that automated store placement and package scheduling, generating $1.4M in revenue uplift, saving 1,000+ operational hours, and reducing costs by $60K+.

Built and productionized an Impact.com cashback integration across multiple services, including CUID/SubID1 attribution, webhook processing, daily transaction reconciliation, commission-rate ingestion, and duplicate protection.

Designed and built a centralized admin audit system with administrator identity and field-level before/after tracking across stores, affiliates, placements, packages, and bulk operations.

Engineered an internal replacement for Microsoft's deprecated CodePush infrastructure using Java, Node.js, and React, maintaining near-instant mobile updates and CI/CD reliability.

Automated merchant and user risk workflows, saving 700+ operational hours annually and supporting compliance and de-risking efforts for a major banking partnership.

Diagnosed production cashback attribution issues across Impact, Sovrn, and CJ, tracing failures across APIs, scheduled jobs, and stored data and adding safeguards against recurring issues.

Built full-stack marketplace and internal tooling across Go, TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, AWS, batch jobs, third-party integrations, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.

Regularly take ambiguous problems from investigation and technical design through implementation, rollout, monitoring, and production support.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · OpenAI API · Go (Programming Language) · Amazon S3

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for frontend development of Annuity/Product Lifecycle Management pages

- Designed and implemented reusable front end components/features used across the entire client facing
platform, decreasing development cost and time by up to 80%
- Documented and standardized Postman collections across engineering teams to increase speed of team onboarding and productivity by 50%
- Automated and maintained the dynamic activation and deactivation of underliers and products via AWS Eventbridge and Python achieving 100% reduction in human operation cost
- Managed CI/CD through Drone, Harness, and Jenkins
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · AngularJS · Front-End Development · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for updating and maintaining a Political fundraising/donation tracking application used by city council, city attorney, etc.

- Developed and improved front-end UI for political fundraising donation tracking application for general use and call times.
- Worked closely with lead engineer to optimize and improve user experience for client use

positions.title: Community Relations Coordinator
positions.description:
Responsible for handling and analyzing data on students to improve communication and outreach

- Work with families in daily communications and inquiry on internally developed systems
- Provide onboarding support and proactively help non-technical families use technology more
effectively for completion of forms and processes to ensure 100% accuracy of data.
- Responsible for event management, data analysis, vendor relations, and student onboarding
- Proactively reach out to parents to ensure they meet deadlines on registrations and forms.
- Partner with and manage DOE entities (safety, custodian, etc.), outside vendors, and elected
officials to effectively and efficiently maintain high expectations for event participants

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
Handled more than 100 clients among 5+ financial agents in helping of processing and onboarding of annuities and life insurance polices.

- Responsible for handling client financial profiles and intermediating on behalf of customer and their insurance/annuities
- Collaborate cross functionally between varying departments and external vendors to
provide positive and clear communication and support to client on behalf of WFG
- Achieve over 90% customer satisfaction among 50 clients via helping with product setup,
solving website issues, and client login
- Setup training and onboarding measures for clients to ensure successful implementation
by other team members and departments

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Present technical product and software information to stakeholders for ease of use and understanding

- Answer ad hoc questions to resolve client issues and improve customer relations through quality control
- Turnkey technical concepts and workflow to non-technical clients and employees

Connects with bank through the Plaid API for ease of use.
